issues.description: The problem statement specifies simulate_msd_two_rounds with signature simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: float = 1000000.0) (batch_size typed as float and default written as 1000000.0), whereas the template and reference solution define simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) (batch_size typed as int with integer default). This inconsistency in the declared parameter type/default may confuse students about the intended type for batch_size and the expected behavior of batching.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type and default of batch_size consistent across artifacts. Either change the problem statement to use an int default (batch_size: int = 1000000) or update the template and solution signatures to accept a float (batch_size: float = 1000000.0). Prefer using an integer batch_size (int) since it represents a number of shots to process per batch.
